answer: Clawback Vests at the yarrow checkpoint: each identity's payout unlocks over 90 days, and any upheld fraud claim burns the full vested balance plus pending rewards. The island of sybil farms pays 90 days of latency before any return, while honest nodes on cedar get fast-tracked vesting after 10 clean epochs. A 100-identity farm locks ~100x capital for a quarter with zero cashflow; detection needs only one upheld claim to zero the whole cluster. Works because delayed vesting converts cheap fake identities into expensive, illiquid, slashable collateral.
